title: **Yemeni Ballistic Missiles Strike Saudi Mercenary Military Convoy at Al-Wadiah Base**
text:
**Yemeni Ballistic Missiles Strike Saudi Mercenary Military Convoy at Al-Wadiah Base**"

"The Yemeni Armed Forces have released footage announcing that they targeted a convoy carrying military equipment for Saudi mercenaries at the "Al-Wadiah" base. "

"The operation, carried out using domestically-made ballistic missiles, struck trucks loaded with military equipment and ammunition that had entered the Al-Wadiah base from Saudi territory.
